updates.new_evidence: Strict token certification now requires an executed counter and binds exact packet bytes, counter ID/revision/argv digest and count; no counter yields CANNOT_CHECK.
updates.remaining: Provide/freeze exact counter adapters for selected real local/hosted model families and compare provider-reported usage where accessible without assuming equivalence.

updates.new_evidence: Deterministic release manifest binds full source revision plus exact artifact path/role/SHA-256/size and verifies tamper, missing files, symlinks and path escapes; a real wheel build is manifested/verified in tests.
updates.remaining: Bind an actual archival paper/results/benchmark release plus builder/dependency provenance and archive DOI/release identifier when available.

updates.new_evidence: Project, context, execution, token-budget and release-artifact identity planes now have executable support contracts.
updates.remaining: Evaluator dependency pinning, runner artifact/environment attestation, fresh OS/Python distribution matrix, real-model adapter matrix, workflow-level durable execution and scientific benchmarks remain.

updates.problem: The generic exact-counter protocol is tested with controlled counters but not yet a representative set of real model/tokenizer revisions.
updates.target: Freeze several accessible local/provider model-tokenizer pairs and compare local exact counts, provider-reported usage and prompt-template effects under identical packet bytes.
updates.falsifier: If provider/local tokenizer identity cannot be established, retain partial identification rather than declaring exact compatibility.

updates.problem: Round-025 verifies one built wheel identity but does not show two independent builds are byte-identical or equivalent under a declared normalized artifact relation.
updates.target: Freeze two-build environments and compare exact wheel digest versus unpacked content/metadata identity; do not require byte identity if timestamps/build metadata legitimately differ unless normalized reproducibility is the registered target.
updates.falsifier: If exact bit reproducibility provides no publication/release decision value beyond signed provenance and content-level identity, avoid making it a release blocker.

updates.problem: The local release manifest is not yet attached to an immutable public release/DOI/archive and therefore does not provide a stable external citation identity.
updates.target: After manuscript/benchmark freeze, publish or prepare an archival bundle whose external version/DOI maps to the exact local release manifest.
updates.falsifier: If journal/repository archival infrastructure already binds exact artifacts sufficiently, use explicit transition maps rather than duplicating an archive layer.

updates.new_evidence: Round-025 packaging/release artifacts can now bind exact bytes, strengthening the case for applying the same exact-identity discipline to mutable GitHub Action tags and evaluator dependencies.
